children: said it is committing $250 million in computing resources over five years to support British research into the safety and security of AI agents, allocating $50 million in access annually.

The initiative will make additional computing capacity available to U.K. researchers studying agentic systems, which can perform tasks with some degree of autonomy. Access will be provided through Nvidia cloud partners based in the country rather than as a direct cash grant.

The program centers on research into the safe development and use of AI agents. The company did not specify which institutions would participate, how researchers would be selected or when the first allocations would become available in the details provided.

Nvidia Chief Executive Jensen Huang said AI capability and safety should advance together. The five-year structure establishes a recurring annual level of support, bringing the total commitment to $250 million. By delivering access through local cloud partners, Nvidia will make computing resources available within the U.K. ecosystem for research focused on agentic safety and security.

title: Nvidia Is Pledging $250 Million for AI Safety. The U.K. Gets Five Years of Computing Power
